title: PR body's pin section still cites the stale r1 pause-stream size (555KB); the stream at this sha is 369,452 bytes
evidence: _pr_body.md: "Green on: boot, pause (5.3 schedule, 555KB), ecmp, surge (crisis re-fire), health_lose (terminal + meter), sla, demolish, bundle, qos_contention, demolish_node, router_tiers." vs the real artifact at this sha: `./bin/harness stats-check pause` -> "  stats pause                live == replay (369452 bytes, byte-identical)". Building the r1 sha (6b09497) in /tmp reproduces "(555483 bytes)" — the number was true at r1 and W6's D-row aggregation shrank the stream ~34% without refreshing the annotation.
detail: AC6's artifact-accuracy class (r1 W3/W4): the PR body misstates the pinned artifact's size at this sha; the rework invalidated the number silently.
recommended_fix: Update the parenthetical to the current size (369,452 bytes, ~361 KiB) or drop the size annotation.

title: `--stats-out ""` (empty path token) silently runs telemetry-off in both CLIs — the empty string doubles as the off-sentinel
evidence: harness/main.odin:118 `if i+1 >= len(rest) || stats_out != "" {` and :128 `if stats_out != "" && len(filtered) != 1 {`; app/main.odin:176 `app.stats_live = stats_path != ""`. Live run: `./bin/harness run qos_contention --stats-out ""` -> RC=0, demo green, NO stream file written, no diagnostic. The W1 fix's own rationale (app/main.odin:143-144): "a DANGLING flag (no path token) is a usage error — the harness rejects it, the app must mirror, never silently run telemetry-off."
detail: A present-but-empty flag value (e.g. `--stats-out $VAR` with VAR unset) bypasses both the W1 usage error and the W2 unwritable-path logging — telemetry silently off, exit 0.
recommended_fix: Track `flag_seen` separately from the value in both parsers; if the flag was seen but the path token is empty, emit the usage error and exit 2.
